items.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra tops Retell’s voice agent benchmark, while Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.

items.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT and power new Oracle offerings.
